title: You Think Cold Logic Makes Wise Choices, Yet Losing Emotion Paralyses Decisions
description:
You were taught to strip all emotion out of big decisions! Yet patients who lose emotion cannot even pick a lunch spot! This is the true story of Antonio Damasio's Iowa Gambling Task. Here is what went wrong with the myth of cold logic.
